text.en: Canada's economy has three main kinds of industry. The first is service industries. They give people thousands of different jobs, for example in transportation, education, health care, construction, banking, communications, stores, tourism and government.
text.fr: L'économie du Canada compte trois grands types d'industries. Le premier est celui des industries de services. Elles offrent des milliers d'emplois différents, par exemple dans les transports, l'éducation, les soins de santé, la construction, les banques, les communications, le commerce de détail, le tourisme et l'administration publique.

source.quote: CANADA’S ECONOMY INCLUDES THREE MAIN TYPES OF INDUSTRIES: • Service industries provide thousands of different jobs in areas like transportation, education, health care, construction, banking, communications, retail services, tourism and government.

verification.evidence: CANADA’S ECONOMY INCLUDES THREE MAIN TYPES OF INDUSTRIES: • Service industries provide thousands of different jobs in areas like transportation, education, health care, construction, banking, communications, retail services, tourism and government.

text.en: More than three out of every four Canadians who have a job work in a service industry.
text.fr: Plus de trois Canadiens sur quatre qui ont un emploi travaillent dans une industrie de services.

source.quote: More than 75% of working Canadians now have jobs in service industries.

verification.evidence: More than 75% of working Canadians now have jobs in service industries.

text.en: The second kind is manufacturing. These industries make products to sell both in Canada and in other countries.
text.fr: Le deuxième type est celui de la fabrication. Ces industries produisent des biens à vendre au Canada comme dans d'autres pays.

source.quote: Manufacturing industries make products to sell in Canada and around the world.

verification.evidence: CANADA’S ECONOMY INCLUDES THREE MAIN TYPES OF INDUSTRIES: … • Manufacturing industries make products to sell in Canada and around the world.

text.en: Canada makes many kinds of goods, such as paper, high-tech equipment, aerospace technology, cars, machines, food and clothing.
text.fr: Le Canada fabrique toutes sortes de biens, comme du papier, du matériel de haute technologie, de la technologie aérospatiale, des automobiles, des machines, des aliments et des vêtements.

source.quote: Manufactured products include paper, high technology equipment, aerospace technology, automobiles, machinery, food, clothing and many other goods.

verification.evidence: Manufactured products include paper, high technology equipment, aerospace technology, automobiles, machinery, food, clothing and many other goods.

text.en: The United States is the country Canada trades with the most.
text.fr: Les États-Unis sont le pays avec lequel le Canada fait le plus de commerce.

source.quote: Our largest international trading partner is the United States.

verification.evidence: Our largest international trading partner is the United States.

text.en: The third kind is natural resources. These industries include forestry, fishing, farming, mining and energy.
text.fr: Le troisième type est celui des ressources naturelles. Ces industries comprennent la foresterie, la pêche, l'agriculture, les mines et l'énergie.

source.quote: Natural resources industries include forestry, fishing, agriculture, mining and energy.

verification.evidence: CANADA’S ECONOMY INCLUDES THREE MAIN TYPES OF INDUSTRIES: … • Natural resources industries include forestry, fishing, agriculture, mining and energy.

text.en: Natural resource industries have played a big part in Canada's history and in how the country grew.
text.fr: Les industries des ressources naturelles ont joué un grand rôle dans l'histoire du Canada et dans son développement.

source.quote: These industries have played an important part in the country’s history and development.

verification.evidence: Natural resources industries include forestry, fishing, agriculture, mining and energy. These industries have played an important part in the country’s history and development.

text.en: Even today, the economy of many parts of the country still relies on developing natural resources.
text.fr: Encore aujourd'hui, l'économie de bien des régions du pays dépend toujours de la mise en valeur des ressources naturelles.

source.quote: Today, the economy of many areas of the country still depends on developing natural resources

verification.evidence: Today, the economy of many areas of the country still depends on developing natural resources, and a large percentage of Canada’s exports are natural resources commodities.

text.en: A large share of what Canada sells to other countries is natural resource products.
text.fr: Une grande part de ce que le Canada vend à l'étranger est faite de produits tirés des ressources naturelles.

source.quote: a large percentage of Canada’s exports are natural resources commodities.

verification.evidence: Today, the economy of many areas of the country still depends on developing natural resources, and a large percentage of Canada’s exports are natural resources commodities.
